classification.rationale: A cotton bib apron is an 'other garment' of heading 6211. HQ 960567 and NY rulings I83101-type classed woven cotton bib aprons in the women's 'other' cotton line (old 6211.42.0081), which maps to 6211.42.10.92 in the current tree.
